items.description: Released OT Cody Ford.
Reinstated DT Maliek Collins from the active/PUP list. Waived CB Tyron Herring from injured reserve and TE Dae'Quan Wright.
Signed TE Mitchell Van Vooren. Waived NT Kelvin Gilliam.
Signed DB Jason Taylor and RB Roydell Williams. Waived RB Kye Robichaux. Placed RB Raheem Blackshear and WR Cedrick Wilson on injured reserve.
Signed LB Reid Carrico. Placed LB Milo Eifler on injured reserve.
Signed DE Niles King. Waived WR Jeff Caldwell.
Released WR Noah Brown.

Signed CB Steven Gilmore and OLB Devean Deal. Reinstated OL Justin Dedich from the active/PUP list. Placed CB Zech McPhearson and OLB Keir Thomas II on injured reserve. Waived/injured LB Daniel Rickert.
Signed TE Ethan Conner and ILB Jaheim Thomas. Waived C Jim Bonifas and CB Ahmari Harvey.
Signed TE Matt Lauter and DL Jonathan Harris. Waived/injured CB Tyreek Chappell and DL Taki Taimani.
Signed OL Jack Conley and P Matt Haack. Released CB Kenneth Harris and WR Kobe Prentice.
Signed K Daniel Carlson. Placed DB Rejzohn Wright on injured reserve.
Waived WR Ryan Miller.
Reverted WR Caullin Lacy, RB Sam Scott and DE Nathan Voorhis to injured reserve after they cleared waivers.
Signed DB Jaylen Mahoney and RB Jordan Mims. Released DB J.T. Gray. Waived RB Ja'Quinden Jackson.

Reinstated LB Josh Sweat from the active/PUP list. Signed Ss Devyn Bobby and Hudson Clark. Released TE Baylor Cupp and WR Bryson Green. Placed WR Xavier Weaver on injured reserve. Waived LB Austin Keys. Waived/injured RB Trey Benson.
Reinstated CB Jalen Ramsey from the active/PUP list. Signed CB Jaylon Guilbeau and RB Alex Tecza. Placed DB Israel Mukuamu on injured reserve.

Signed DE Viliami Fehoko. Acquired LB Deion Jones from New Orleans in exchange for RB Zamir White. Released TE Josiah Deguara. Waived DE Titus Leo and TE Tanner McLachlan. Reverted LB Xavier Thomas to injured reserve after he cleared waivers.
Waived RB Anthony Hankerson.
Reverted DB Devon Marshall to injured reserve after he cleared waivers.

Acquired WR Kayshon Boutte from New England in exchange for DB Jaylen Reed and a 2028 seventh-round draft pick. Signed RB Deuce Vaughn, LB Caleb Johnson and S George Odum. Released WR Juwann Winfree. Waived WR Jha'Quan Jackson and RB Josh Pitsenberger. Waived/injured LB Marte Mapu.
Signed DE Derek Barnett to a one-year contract. Placed DE Alex Wright on injured reserve.
Placed C Tyler Biadasz on injured reserve.
Re-signed TE Khalil Dinkins to a three-year contract. Reinstated TE George Kittle from the active/physically unable to perform list.
Placed CB Chigozie Anusiem on injured reserve.
